page_title: JUV 3-2 FRO | Juventus v Frosinone 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' 3 - 2 Daniele Rugani (Juventus) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
90+5' There's an opportunity for Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+5' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Pol Lirola will be replaced by Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone).
90+4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Close! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
89' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) brought his opponent down.
88' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Cerofolini, who smothers the ball.
87' Here comes a substitution. Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) is brought on as a substitute for Marco Brescianini.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Demba Seck (Frosinone) comes onto the pitch for Matias Soule.
86' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Weston McKennie is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
86' Federico Gatti goes off the pitch and Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) comes on.
85' Weston McKennie (Juventus) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
83' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
82' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.
79' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) replacing Abdou Harroui.
72' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Walid Cheddira.
72' The game is interrupted. Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
70' Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
69' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
66' Timothy Weah (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
65' Timothy Weah (Juventus) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
64' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
62' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Filip Kostic and he is replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
62' Federico Chiesa will be replaced by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).

61' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
60' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
58' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.

57' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
56' The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.

53' Daniele Rugani (Juventus) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
52' Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
52' Matias Soule (Frosinone) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
51' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
51' The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
49' Matias Soule (Frosinone) sends the corner into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny intercepts it and averts the threat.
49' None of the Frosinone players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out for a corner. Frosinone can continue in their attacking effort.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A lofted cross from Federico Gatti (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
44' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
40' Frosinone control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
38' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
37' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
32' 2 - 2 Goal! Weston McKennie shows great vision to find Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
30' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Michele Cerofolini (Frosinone).

30' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
29' Problems for Massimiliano Allegri as Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Carlos Alcaraz replaces him.
27' 1 - 2 Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the roof of the net and past the goalkeeper.
26' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Juventus.
22' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
21' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) picks up an injury.
19' Frosinone seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

16' Wasted effort! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.

14' Nadir Zortea showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:1.
12' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) brings his opponent down. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bremer (Juventus) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
6' Frosinone have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Weston McKennie inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
2' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano will supervise the game today.
